title.ja: 図1-1 序盤の一例
title.en: Figure 1-1: An example opening

explain.ja: 図1-1は序盤から数手進んだ局面です。ここから飛車をうまく使う手を考えます。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is a position a few moves into the opening. Consider how to use the rook well from here.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図1-2 飛車先の歩を突き捨てる
title.en: Figure 1-2: Sacrifice the rook-file pawn

explain.ja: 図1-2から飛車の前の歩を前に進めました。この指し手を「飛車先の歩を突く」といいます。飛車先の歩を相手に取られましたが、これには狙いがありました。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-2 the pawn in front of the rook advanced. This move is called pushing the rook pawn. The rook pawn was captured by the opponent, but there was a purpose in it.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図1-3 飛車先の歩を交換
title.en: Figure 1-3: Exchange the rook-file pawns

explain.ja: 飛車を前に進めて相手の歩を取り返しました。図1-3ではお互いに歩を1枚持ち駒にしています。このように飛車先の歩を突いて歩を取り合う手を「飛車先の歩を交換する」といいます。
explain.en: The rook advanced and recaptured the opponent's pawn. In Diagram 1-3 each side holds one pawn in hand. Pushing the rook pawn and trading pawns like this is called exchanging the rook pawn.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図1-4 飛車を戻す
title.en: Figure 1-4: Return the rook

explain.ja: 相手は2三に歩を打って守り、こちらは飛車を後ろに引きました。ここまでが飛車先の歩を交換する一連の手です。飛車先の歩の交換には3つの得があります。歩を1枚持ち駒にできること、飛車が敵陣に直通すること、2五に駒を進出できることです。序盤では、飛車先の歩を交換できるかどうかが分岐点になります。
explain.en: The opponent defends by dropping a pawn on 2三, and the rook retreats. That completes the sequence of exchanging the rook pawn. It has three benefits: you get a pawn in hand, the rook has a direct line into the enemy camp, and you can advance a piece to 2五. In the opening, whether you can exchange the rook pawn is a branching point.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図1-5 序盤の一例
title.en: Figure 1-5: An example opening

explain.ja: 今度も初手から数手進めた局面です。先ほどと違って、飛車先の歩を交換できない形になっているのがわかるでしょうか。
explain.en: This is again a position a few moves from the start. Unlike before, notice that the rook pawn cannot be exchanged.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図1-6 今度は▲2四飛と進めない
title.en: Figure 1-6: This time the rook cannot advance to ▲2四

explain.ja: 先ほどと同じように▲2四歩、△同歩と進めても、次に飛車を前に進められません。図1-6から▲2四飛としても、△同角と飛車を取られます。飛車先の歩を交換できるかどうかは戦法を決める大きなポイントで、相手に飛車先を交換されるのを防ぐかどうかとも言えます。角の使い方は角道を開けるか閉じるかの2つで、図2-1が開けた状態、図2-2が閉じた状態です。
explain.en: As before, even after ▲2四歩 △同歩 the rook cannot advance next. If you play ▲2四飛 from Diagram 1-6, White captures the rook with △同角. Whether you can exchange the rook pawn is a big factor in choosing a strategy, which can also be seen as whether you prevent the opponent from exchanging it. The bishop has two uses: opening or closing its diagonal; Diagram 2-1 shows it open and Diagram 2-2 closed.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する?しない?
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn or not?

title.ja: 図2-1 角道が開いている
title.en: Figure 2-1: The bishop diagonal is open

explain.ja: 将棋の戦法における角の使い方は、角道を開けるか閉じるかの2つです。図2-1は角道を開けている状態で、図2-2は閉じている状態です。角道が開いていると、角が動ける範囲が広くなります。
explain.en: In shogi openings, there are two ways to use the bishop: opening or closing its diagonal. Figure 2-1 shows the bishop's diagonal open and Figure 2-2 shows it closed. With the diagonal open, the bishop has a wider range of movement.

section.ja: 角道を開ける?閉じる?
section.en: Open or close the bishop diagonal?

title.ja: 図2-2 角道が閉じている
title.en: Figure 2-2: The bishop diagonal is closed

explain.ja: 角の使い方は、角道が開いているかどうかで決まります。飛車先を交換するか、角道を開けるかのそれぞれ2パターンがあるので、2×2で4種類の戦法があります。飛車先を交換しない場合は、角道を閉じれば矢倉戦法、開ければ角換わりです。飛車先を交換する場合は、角道を閉じれば相掛かり、開ければ横歩取りです。大駒を使いやすくする戦法ほど戦いが激しくなり、矢倉戦法、角換わり、相掛かり、横歩取りの順に穏やかで初心者に指しやすいとされます。
explain.en: How the bishop is used depends on whether its diagonal is open. Combining exchanging the rook pawn or not with opening the bishop diagonal or not gives 2×2 = 4 strategies. Without exchanging the rook pawn, closing the bishop diagonal gives Yagura and opening it gives Bishop Exchange. With the rook pawn exchanged, closing gives Aigakari and opening gives Yokofudori. Strategies that make major pieces easier to use lead to fiercer fights; in order Yagura, Bishop Exchange, Aigakari, Yokofudori are said to go from calm and beginner-friendly to fierce.

section.ja: 角道を開ける?閉じる?
section.en: Open or close the bishop diagonal?

title.ja: 図3-1 矢倉戦法の一例
title.en: Figure 3-1: An example of Yagura

explain.ja: 矢倉戦法は、飛車先の交換を防ぎ、角道も閉じる戦法です。お互いにじっくり守りを固める展開になりやすく、初心者にも指しやすいと言われます。一般には矢倉囲いを目指します。
explain.en: Yagura keeps the opponent from exchanging the rook pawn and closes the bishop diagonal. Both sides tend to build their defenses patiently, and it is said to be easy for beginners. Generally you aim for the Yagura castle.

section.ja: 飛車も角も大人しく使う、「矢倉戦法」
section.en: Using rook and bishop quietly: the "Yagura strategy"

title.ja: 図3-2 角換わりの一例
title.en: Figure 3-2: An example of Bishop Exchange

explain.ja: 飛車先の交換を防ぐ代わりに、角道を開けたまま戦うのが角換わりです。基本的に角を交換して戦います。矢倉戦法より戦いが激しくなりますが、非常によく現れる形なのでしっかり勉強したい戦法です。
explain.en: Bishop Exchange prevents the rook-pawn exchange but keeps the bishop diagonal open; the bishops are basically traded. The fighting is fiercer than Yagura, but it appears very often, so it is worth studying well.

section.ja: 角をダイナミックに使う、「角換わり」
section.en: Use the bishop dynamically: Bishop Exchange

title.ja: 図3-3 相掛かりの一例
title.en: Figure 3-3: An example of Double Wing Attack

explain.ja: お互いに角道を開けず、飛車先の歩を交換するのが相掛かり戦法です。激しい戦いになることが多く、初心者には指しこなすのが難しいとされます。
explain.en: In Aigakari neither side opens the bishop diagonal and the rook pawns are exchanged. It often leads to fierce fights and is considered hard for beginners to handle.

section.ja: 飛車先を交換する、「相掛かり」
section.en: Exchange the rook pawn: "Aigakari"

title.ja: 図3-4 横歩取りの一例
title.en: Figure 3-4: An example of Side Pawn Capture

explain.ja: お互いに角道を開けた状態で飛車先の歩を交換し合うのが横歩取りです。非常に激しい戦いになり、プロの将棋ではよく指されますが、アマチュアでは苦手にしている人も多い戦型です。
explain.en: In Yokofudori both sides open the bishop diagonal and exchange the rook pawns. It leads to very fierce fights; it is common in professional games, but many amateurs find it difficult. You do not need to learn all of them: beginners are advised to start with Yagura and Bishop Exchange, and Yagura, which tends to be calm, is best for a first strategy, especially as Black since the position is easy to steer into Yagura.

section.ja: 飛車も角も大暴れ、「横歩取り」
section.en: Rook and bishop run wild: "Yokofudori"

title.ja: 図4-1 まずは角道を開ける
title.en: Figure 4-1: First, open the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: この図は後手を下にしています。先手がまず▲2六歩としたら、△3四歩と指しましょう。
explain.en: This diagram has White at the bottom. When Black first plays ▲2六歩, answer with △3四歩.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図4-2 飛車先の交換を防ぐ
title.en: Figure 4-2: Prevent the rook-file pawn exchange

explain.ja: 先手が飛車先の歩を伸ばしてきたら、△3三角として相手の飛車先の歩の交換を防ぐのがポイントです。矢倉戦法も角換わりも、相手の飛車先の交換を防ぐ戦法です。
explain.en: If Black pushes the rook pawn, the key is △3三角 to prevent the opponent from exchanging the rook pawn. Both Yagura and Bishop Exchange prevent the opponent's rook-pawn exchange.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図4-3 角換わりの形に
title.en: Figure 4-3: Into Bishop Exchange shape

explain.ja: 先手が角道を開けてきたら、△2二銀とするのが角換わりの形です。ここから相手が角交換してくれば角換わりになります。
explain.en: If Black opens the bishop diagonal, △2二銀 is the Bishop Exchange form. If the opponent then exchanges bishops, it becomes Bishop Exchange.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図4-4 相手が角道を開けてきた場合
title.en: Figure 4-4: If the opponent opens the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: 図4-1から先手がいきなり角道を開けてきた場合を見ます。矢倉戦法も角換わりも3三に銀を持っていくのが好形ですが、どう指せば銀を前に出せるでしょうか。不用意に銀を動かすと、こちらの角が相手の角に取られます。
explain.en: Consider the case where Black suddenly opens the bishop diagonal from Diagram 4-1. In both Yagura and Bishop Exchange, bringing the silver to 3三 is a good shape, but how can you advance it? If you move the silver carelessly, your bishop is captured by the opponent's bishop.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図4-5 角交換する
title.en: Figure 4-5: Exchange bishops

explain.ja: 図4-4からは、こちらから角交換します。これで角換わりの戦型になります。
explain.en: From Diagram 4-4, exchange bishops yourself. This makes it a Bishop Exchange game.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図4-6 銀で飛車先の交換を防ぐ
title.en: Figure 4-6: Prevent the rook-file exchange with the silver

explain.ja: 図4-5からは、銀を前に繰り出して相手の飛車先の交換を防ぎます。相手が飛車先の歩を交換しようとしても、銀が2四に利いています。
explain.en: From Diagram 4-5, advance the silver to prevent the opponent's rook-pawn exchange. Even if the opponent tries to exchange it, the silver covers 2四.

section.ja: こちらが後手の場合は相手の出方を見て矢倉戦法or角換わりに
section.en: As White, wait and choose Yagura or Bishop Exchange depending on the opponent's approach

title.ja: 図5-1 棒銀
title.en: Figure 5-1: Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 図5-1は棒銀と呼ばれる攻めの形です。棒銀は矢倉戦法でも角換わりでも使える攻めの基本形です。初心者はまず棒銀の攻め筋を勉強するのが良いでしょう。将棋の戦法はこの4つ以外にもあります。ここで紹介した戦法はどれも飛車を最初の位置から動かさない居飛車で、飛車を横に動かして使う戦法は振り飛車と呼ばれます。四間飛車はその基本戦法です。
explain.en: Diagram 5-1 shows an attack called Climbing Silver. It is a basic attacking form usable in both Yagura and Bishop Exchange, and beginners should study its attacking patterns first. There are more strategies than these four. All the strategies shown here keep the rook on its original file, called Static Rook; strategies that move the rook sideways are called Ranging Rook, and Fourth File Rook is the basic one.

section.ja: 矢倉戦法でも、角換わりでも使える棒銀の攻め!
section.en: Climbing Silver attack, usable in both Yagura and Bishop Exchange

title.ja: 図6-1 四間飛車の基本
title.en: Figure 6-1: Basics of Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: 先手と後手の居飛車と振り飛車の組み合わせで、将棋の戦法はかなりの数になります。まずは一つずつ得意戦法を増やし、地道に勉強していきましょう。
explain.en: Combining Static Rook and Ranging Rook for Black and White gives a large number of strategies. Add one strategy you are good at at a time and study steadily.

section.ja: 居飛車?振り飛車?将棋の戦法はまだまだある
section.en: Static Rook or Ranging Rook? There are many more shogi strategies
